prompt: Rendered in the style of an oil painting, this scene unfolds within a lush botanical greenhouse where sunlight filters through glass panes. On the left stands a woman in a yellow dress, her hand resting gently on a large fern leaf. Beside her, a small terrier with white fur sits patiently on the stone floor, looking up expectantly. In the center, a man in a blue apron holds a watering can, pouring water onto a potted orchid that blooms vibrantly on a wooden table. To his right, a child in a green hat points excitedly at a hanging basket of ivy. Next to the child, an elderly person in a gray coat observes the plants with quiet interest, leaning slightly on a cane. Above them all, a parrot with bright red feathers perches on a high beam, watching the activity below. The woman in the yellow dress is handing a seed packet to the man in the blue apron, who accepts it with a nod. The child in the green hat is standing next to the elderly person in the gray coat, sharing the view. There is no modern technology visible in this timeless setting, preserving the natural atmosphere of the garden sanctuary.
